verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: The PR introduces a cached `_key_cache` in `__hash__` but does not update the equality comparison (which relies on `_key`). After pickling a base‑version object (which stores `_key_cache = None`) and unpickling it with the new code, the cached hash key is computed lazily while equality still uses the uncached key, causing two equal logical versions to compare unequal.
evidence: def __hash__(self) -> int: ... if self._key_cache is None: self._key_cache = _cmpkey(...) ... return hash(self._key_cache)
def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool: ... return self._key == other._key
rejected: PR title: perf: skip hash property
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["0"], pickled, then unpickled by head loads, but no longer equals a freshly built head object (== gives False).
